title: Loot Insight
description: Displays detailed item stats (durability, enchantments) in a clean AR interface. Works on any server
body:
# Loot Insight

**Loot Insight** is a lightweight client-side mod that adds a visual interface to dropped items. Instead of picking up an item to check its stats, simply look at it.

### Features
* **Visual Durability:** See exact durability numbers with color-coded status (Green -> Red).
* **Enchantment List:** Instantly see all enchantments on weapons and armor directly in the world.
* **Clean UI:** The interface is optimized to be readable but unobtrusive.
* **Client-Side Only:** Works on any server! You don't need it installed on the server side.
